# llms.txt — OpenCode Cross-Talk

> Durable verifiable messaging between LLM sessions (OpenCode): outbox, ACK/NACK,
> retries, idempotency, DLQ. PowerShell CLI + local HTTP API.

## Start here
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): bootstrap for LLM sessions — identify, connect, send/receive tasks. Read this first.
- [QUICKSTART.md](QUICKSTART.md): human-oriented 3-minute quick start.

## Protocol & usage
- [CROSS_TALK.md](CROSS_TALK.md): complete protocol specification (envelope v2, states, leases).
- [USER_GUIDE.md](USER_GUIDE.md): usage guide without touching code.
- [README.md](README.md): overview, features, architecture.

## Operations
- [TROUBLESHOOTING section in README](README.md#troubleshooting): common failures and fixes.
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): version history.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): how to contribute.

## Platform notes
- [CROSS_WINDOWS.md](CROSS_WINDOWS.md): Windows/PowerShell 5.1 pitfalls (BOM, curl.exe, CRLF).
